article.summary_es: El Ejército de Salvación en Jackson Heights ofrece un comedor social de lunes a viernes y una despensa de alimentos los jueves. Está en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: The Salvation Army in Jackson Heights offers a soup kitchen Monday to Friday and a food pantry on Thursdays. It is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Comedor social de lunes a viernes, 11:30am a 1pm.
Despensa de alimentos los jueves, 10am a 11am.
La lista no detalla qué alimentos dan ni los requisitos.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen open Monday to Friday, 11:30am to 1pm.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements.
visit_tips_es: El comedor social funciona de lunes a viernes, 11:30am a 1pm.
La despensa de alimentos abre solo los jueves, 10am a 11am.
Llame al (718) 335-3693 antes de ir para confirmar detalles.
visit_tips_en: The soup kitchen runs Monday to Friday, 11:30am to 1pm.
The food pantry is open only on Thursdays, 10am to 11am.
Call (718) 335-3693 before visiting to confirm details.
